{{Quote|Good, lets get down to business. Unlike my brother, I do things the old fashioned way. I snuck into the facility, and took notes for the items we will need. I will need you to collect three items for me.|Tupit|<ref name="SWG:HT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Help Tupit|Endor}}</ref>}}
'''Tupit''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who lived with her brother named [[Galody]] in a [[Galody and Tupit's home|home]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Tupit was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:NS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Tupit was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:IG-88|"IG-88" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:NS" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|"Chapter 7" update]], on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref>
